card.name: Connecting words in invention and technology text
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation (people, comma, be, are, to, such) inside passages about inventions, patents and technology. The pole sits on the word that comes just before a technical or innovation term.

modes.label: Patent law text
modes.description: Linking words and punctuation inside explanations of patent rules, novelty and inventiveness.
modes.example: The invention must<< be>> "useful", meaning it must perform

modes.label: Technology and innovation prose
modes.description: Linking words in general text about new technologies, science projects and innovation.
modes.example: New concepts such as photonic lattices, which are expected to have significant technological impact,<< are>> emerging.
